# cim

Central infrastructure management for SiteConfig clusters: metal3, the assisted service and the SiteConfig component

```yaml
stack:
  cim:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Settings the converters read.

Under `stack.cim.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `storage` | AgentServiceConfig volumes. Sizes can grow; nothing else changes once the PVCs exist. |  |
| `storage.storageClass` | Empty uses the cluster default. The field is then omitted, since an empty string disables provisioning. | `''` |
| `storage.database` |  | `10Gi` |
| `storage.filesystem` |  | `100Gi` |
| `storage.images` | RHCOS ISO cache: about 2Gi per osImages entry | `50Gi` |
| `osImages` | RHCOS live ISOs you host, by OpenShift x.y: {version: RHCOS version, url}. Set when disconnected, as it replaces the default list: list every version a siteconfig cluster installs. Mirrors and CAs come from the disconnected element's config (docs/disconnected.md). | `{}` |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `hub`

`hub-cim-<cluster>`: Provisioning, AgentServiceConfig and the SiteConfig component.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hub-cim-provisioning` | enforce | [cim-provisioning](converters/cim-provisioning.yaml) | Provisioning provisioning-configuration |
| `hub-cim-mirror` | enforce | [cim-mirror](converters/cim-mirror.yaml) (mustonlyhave) | Mirror registries and OS image CA for the assisted service |
| `hub-cim-agent` | enforce | [cim-agent](converters/cim-agent.yaml) | AgentServiceConfig agent |
| `hub-cim-siteconfig` | enforce | [cim-siteconfig](converters/cim-siteconfig.yaml) | MultiClusterHub siteconfig component |

### Policy `ready`

`ready-cim-<cluster>`: Reports NonCompliant until metal3, the assisted service and SiteConfig run. Depends on `hub-cim-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ready-cim-health` | inform (always) | [cim-health](converters/cim-health.yaml) | metal3, the AgentServiceConfig and the SiteConfig controller |
